config.title: Ice Hockey and Basketball at Uber Arena - FAQ
config.subtitle: Two confirmed September fixtures, ticket checks and a practical Friedrichshain evening.

items.q: Which Uber Arena games are confirmed for 17 and 18 September 2026?
items.a: Eisbären Berlin play Straubing Tigers at 19:30 on Thursday 17 September. ALBA BERLIN play NINERS Chemnitz at 20:00 on Friday 18 September.

items.q: How should I check Eisbären and ALBA ticket prices?
items.a: Read the official seller's current price, seat category, fee and availability details before paying. Those live terms can change and the fixture listing alone does not settle the final ticket cost.

items.q: Which game should I choose in Berlin?
items.a: Choose hockey for the rink atmosphere and basketball for the faster court rhythm. The right choice is the sport you actually want to watch and the ticket category that fits your evening.

items.q: Are Uber Arena sports games in English?
items.a: Do not assume so. The official fixture listings do not promise English-language announcements, screen content, service or commentary.

items.q: How should I plan the journey home after an Uber Arena game?
items.a: Use the live BVG or VBB route on the day and keep the after-game plan optional. A game can run differently from the starting time on the fixture page.
